name: Base Sandbox Dev Container
description: Hardened Debian trixie dev container for coding agents: node 24, OS Python/pip/pipx, uv, github-cli, copilot-cli, claude-code, az-cli, otel-collector, speckit, superfile and herdr - baked into a pre-built image without Dev Container Features. No sudo, no SSH host keys in the image, no host sockets or credentials passed in.

sshdPort.description: Port sshd listens on inside the container. Read at container start, so it can be changed without rebuilding the image.

startSshd.description: Start sshd on every container start. Set to false to leave the port closed; the host keys are then generated the first time you start it by hand.
